objective: Review the non-executing native-parser adapter-payload to sidecar plan-resolution fixture implementation and accept only the explicit-context template-plan fixture, while selecting a readiness/status hardening boundary before any sidecar handoff contract, command synthesis, execution, timing, arbitrary RTL/filelist support, automatic allocation, upstream regression success, or upstream landing claim.

review_decision.reason: The helper remains importable and non-executing. It requires the reviewed adapter payload plus explicit target, mode, template or registry-entry context, validates adapter shape and reviewed slice-template identity, and reaches only the existing sidecar_stage_plan authority. Parser source_files, filelists, and ordinary Verilator arguments remain preserved inputs rather than source closure, dependency expansion, or command synthesis.
review_decision.weakest_point: The implementation currently exposes an outer status of planned even though sidecar_stage_plan may return unsupported_for_stage_plan or planned_not_ready_for_verilator_option_shim for non-template or resident modes. That is narrow enough to accept as a template-plan fixture, but the next gate must define status/readiness hardening before treating this path as a reliable direct-Verilator handoff boundary.
accepted_because: payload-only resolution is rejected through required explicit sidecar context fields
target, mode, template or target_registry_entry, and source_gate_or_manifest_ref are required before sidecar_stage_plan is called
slice-template targets must match the reviewed target registry template
adapter shape must match state_count x step_count
adapter correctness_policy_ref remains coverage_output_equivalence and reference-only
parser source_files and filelists are reported as preserved inputs, not source closure or filelist expansion
sidecar_handoff_contract, command synthesis, operator plan, efficiency estimation, execution, measurement, runtime or ABI changes remain absent

accepted_scope.accepted_target_kind: reviewed slice_template targets with matching template or registry entry

required_next_gate.name: define_verilator_native_option_parser_sidecar_plan_resolution_status_hardening_gate

the smallest in-place helper hardening allowed before sidecar_handoff_contract, command synthesis, operator plan, execution, timing, or runtime/ABI work

coverage-output equivalence for a native-parser flow
